grade.title: GradeValue

metrics.description: The metrics of the window (ADR 0002, A5-A10). A metric whose denominator is empty reports its best value.

onTimeHandoverRate.description: Packages handed over on or before requiredShipBy, over packages handed over. Higher is better.

lateAckRate.description: Purchase orders acknowledged in the last 10% of their ack window or expired, over purchase orders acknowledged or expired. Lower is better.

rejectRate.description: Purchase orders rejected over purchase orders acknowledged or expired. Lower is better.

expiryRate.description: Purchase orders expired over purchase orders acknowledged or expired. Lower is better.

promiseKeptRate.description: Promises kept over promises kept plus promises broken by a node-attributable cause. Higher is better.

feedFreshnessP95Minutes.description: 95th percentile (nearest rank) of the whole minutes between consecutive applied inventory feeds of the node. Lower is better.

inboundTimelinessP95Minutes.description: Informational, never graded (ADR 0009). 95th percentile (nearest rank) of the whole minutes between a shipment's InboundShipmentShipped.shippedAt and the receivedAt of its InboundReceiptSubmitted, over the receipts received inside the window; a receipt stamped before its shipment counts as 0. Omitted when no receipt joined to its shipment falls in the window. Lower is better.

inboundAccuracyRate.description: Informational, never graded (ADR 0009). Cartons reported RECEIVED over all cartons reported by the receipts received inside the window (joined to their shipment). Omitted when the window holds no such carton. Higher is better.

computedAt.description: When the last recompute ran; omitted before the first one.
